headline: Order surge and margin gains lift EPS guidance higher
summary_short: Xylem's Q2 2026 revenue rose 1.5% y/y to $2,336M (up 2% reported, 1% organic) as orders jumped 42% reported/41% organic; diluted EPS climbed 19% to $1.11 ($1.46 adjusted), and the company raised its FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance to $5.55-$5.70 from $5.35-$5.60.
summary_long: Revenue grew 2% reported (1% organic) to $2,336M as orders surged 42% reported/41% organic. Diluted EPS rose 19% to $1.11 ($1.46 adjusted), with net income up 16% to $263M on strong operational performance and lower restructuring costs, partly offset by higher income tax and a $16M loss on business sales. Adjusted EBITDA margin expanded 150bp to 23.3% on productivity savings, price realization, and favorable mix. Cash rose to $1,276M after $1,243M of H1 buybacks and $990M of new long-term debt. Xylem trimmed FY2026 revenue growth guidance (~2% reported, 2-3% organic) but raised adjusted EPS guidance to $5.55-$5.70 and held free cash flow margin guidance at 10.2-11.0%.
